title: 第15章 能做到的人已经被你赶走了第16章 求人就要有求人的态度
slug: 被逐出宗门后师尊师姐后悔终生
content_zh:
霞光冲天而起，驻留在半空中，显露出了一道风华绝代的身影。
只见慕流苏白发飞扬，手持宝剑而立，浑身散发着神圣的气息。
倏忽间她动了，手捏剑诀，对着苍天劈出了犀利一剑。
“轰！”
层云尽裂，显露出了万里晴空！
“剑阵起，道法招来！”
她轻声念道，柔语悠扬，紧接着玉清宗内就亮起了道道法阵，足足有八十一道，与高台上的每个弟子相互对应。
看到这一幕，周通终于释然了，这群家伙果然重复利用了以前的阵法！
高台上的八十一人似有所感，纷纷舞动剑器，施展着不同的剑法，纯熟干练，仿佛演示过了千百遍。
正当此时，莫流苏一剑劈落，高台的最底层立刻又浮现出了一道更大的剑阵，将一切囊括于其中。
“这就是引来天道注视的仪式吗？竟然如此的恢宏广大，让我有一种窒息的感觉。”
其他宗门到场的长老呼吸晦涩，他们还是第一次见到这种景象。
毫无疑问，这是沟通剑道的典仪，一旦引来天道注视，唐七的剑道修为必然会出现质的飞跃！
话音未落，只见无数天材地宝腾空而起，在半空中炸开，变成精纯的灵气，汇聚到高台上唐七的身边。
这一幕令众人倒抽凉气，那些宝物每一件都价值连城，玉清宗却毫不犹豫的用上了，他们到底有多看重这个弟子？
“看清楚了吗？废物，这就是小师弟应得的待遇，你永远都比不上他！”
葛红秋还在蹦哒，绞尽脑汁的想要让周通破防，显然她很清楚曾经的周通最在意什么，只可惜，那个周通早就不存在了。
“滚！”
回应她的又是一记响亮的耳光，小妖女头都不回，就将其扇飞了出去。
“噗嗤！”

一口鲜血喷出，葛红秋满眼怨恨，却没有人在意她。
高台之上，唐七开眼，缓缓的站了起来。
他俯瞰着下方，目光逡巡，立刻就找到了周通的位置。
“真是如蝼蚁一般！”
他嘴角上扬，意气风发，从现在开始，他将远远的将周通甩在身后，两人再也不能相提并论！
“勾天通地，引大道出，剑来！”
唐七怒吼，一柄金色长剑破空飞来，落在了他的掌心中。
此乃天道剑，是一柄礼器，却也能在剑中称尊，唐七持此剑施展剑道，周身绽放出了万丈光芒。
“轰隆！！”
苍穹之上，传出了异样的波动。
众人屏住呼吸，他们看到了一只巨大的竖眼开合，像是苍天之眼，目光锁定了唐七。
“成功了，竟然真的成功了，这唐七要逆天啊，将稳坐年轻一辈第一人了。”
“哈哈哈…这种感觉，可真是非同凡响。”
唐七大笑着，肉眼可见的剑道波纹顺着目光灌输到他的体内，让他的气息变得无比犀利，犹如一柄出鞘的宝剑。
莫流苏和陈灵儿不约而同的向了周通所在的方向。
然而周通没有任何异样，甚至还在和小妖女举杯对饮，好不快活。
“到了这个时候还在硬装，真是可怜，就像是跳梁小丑一般！”陈灵儿道。
“小七，感觉如何？”莫流苏俯身询问唐七。
content_en:
The rays of light rose into the sky and stayed in mid-air, revealing a figure of unrivaled splendor.
Mu Liusu's white hair was flying, standing with a sword in his hand, exuding a sacred aura.
Suddenly she moved, holding the sword secret in her hand, and struck a sharp sword towards the sky.
"Boom!"
The clouds broke apart, revealing a clear sky!
"The sword formation rises, the Taoism comes!"
She whispered softly, her words melodious, and then the arrays of magic arrays lit up in the Yuqing Sect, with a total of eighty-one arrays, corresponding to each disciple on the high platform.
Seeing this scene, Zhou Tong was finally relieved. These guys had indeed reused the previous formations!
The eighty-one people on the high platform seemed to be aware of this, and they all danced their swords and performed different sword techniques with proficiency and skill, as if they had demonstrated it thousands of times.
At this moment, Mo Liusu struck down with his sword, and a larger sword formation immediately appeared at the bottom of the platform, encompassing everything.
"Is this a ceremony that attracts the attention of heaven? It's so majestic and vast that it makes me feel suffocated."
The elders from other sects present were breathing heavily. This was the first time they had seen such a scene.
There is no doubt that this is a ceremony to communicate the way of swordsmanship. Once it attracts the attention of Heaven, Tang Qi's swordsmanship cultivation will inevitably make a qualitative leap!
Before he finished speaking, countless heavenly and earthly treasures were seen rising into the sky, exploding in mid-air, turning into pure spiritual energy, and gathering around Tang Qi on the high platform.
This scene made everyone gasp. Each of those treasures was priceless, but the Yuqing Sect used them without hesitation. How much did they value this disciple?
"Do you see clearly? Trash, this is the treatment that my junior brother deserves. You will never be as good as him!"
Ge Hongqiu was still jumping around, racking her brains to let Zhou Tong break his defense. It was obvious that she knew what Zhou Tong cared about most, but unfortunately, that Zhou Tong no longer existed.
"Get out!"
She received another loud slap in the face in response, and the little demon girl slapped her away without even looking back.
"Pfft!"
A mouthful of blood spurted out, Ge Hongqiu's eyes were full of resentment, but no one paid attention to her.
On the high platform, Tang Qi opened his eyes and slowly stood up.
He looked down, his eyes wandering, and he immediately found Zhou Tong's location.
"Really like ants!"
The corners of his mouth raised, and he was full of energy. From now on, he would leave Zhou Tong far behind, and the two of them could no longer be compared!
"Connect the heavens and the earth, lead the great road out, come the sword!"
Tang Qi roared angrily, and a golden long sword flew through the air and landed in his palm.
This is the Tiandao Sword, a ritual weapon, but it can also be revered in the sword. Tang Qi held this sword and performed swordsmanship, and his whole body burst into light.
"Boom!!"
There were strange fluctuations in the sky.
Everyone held their breath as they saw a huge vertical eye opening and closing, like the eye of the sky, its gaze locked on Tang Qi.
"It's successful, it's really successful. This Tang Qi is going to defy the heavens and will surely be the number one among the younger generation."
"Hahaha... This feeling is really extraordinary."
Tang Qi laughed, and the ripples of the sword path visible to the naked eye followed his gaze and instilled into his body, making his aura extremely sharp, like an unsheathed sword.
Mo Liusu and Chen Ling'er unanimously headed in the direction of Zhou Tong.
However, Zhou Tong didn't feel any strange. He was even toasting with the little demon girl, enjoying himself very much.
"It's really pitiful that you're still pretending to be a show-off at this point, just like a clown!" Chen Ling'er said.
"Xiao Qi, how do you feel?" Mo Liusu leaned over and asked Tang Qi.
